# hey_stripe documentation

`hey_stripe` provides Stripe Checkout, Billing Portal, subscription reads, and
webhook classification/verification primitives for Hey. MMeoww remains the
authoritative source of entitlement truth; Stripe is a provider.

- `docs/GETTING_STARTED.md` — configure the API key and create a Checkout session.
- `docs/DESIGN.md` — request forms, webhook signature verification, boundaries.
- `docs/TESTING.md` — pure spec suite and the optional live HTTP probe.
- `docs/ROADMAP.md` — planned surface.
- `docs/examples/basic.hey` — a runnable, network-free capability example.
